text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2051 for the Senior Software Engineer position. Their strongest evidence includes a computer science degree and experience listed as "Python" and "React". Key gaps include missing requirements for vue.js, node.js, and aws, as well as having 0.5 years less experience than the implied four-year requirement. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, the application has been escalated for further review.
